title: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature Monthly 0.05° (MOD11C3 v061)
description: Monthly daytime and night-time land surface temperature and emissivity from the Terra MODIS sensor on a 0.05° Climate Modeling Grid, distributed by NASA's Land Processes DAAC.
purpose: Land surface temperature supports heat-stress, drought and surface energy-balance analysis across Algeria's cropland, steppe and desert surfaces.

provider.name: NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center (LP DAAC)

creator: Zhengming Wan, Simon Hook, Glynn Hulley

license.name: NASA Earth science data — open, no restrictions on use (EOSDIS data use policy)

citation: Wan, Z., Hook, S., Hulley, G. (2021). MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG V061 [Data set]. NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/MODIS/MOD11C3.061

spatial_extent.description: Global 0.05° Climate Modeling Grid. Algeria must be subset by the user.

temporal_extent.description: February 2000 onward. NASA has announced that Terra MODIS acquisitions cease on 1 December 2026, so the record ends then.

processing: Monthly composites of clear-sky land surface temperature retrieved from MODIS thermal infrared observations, aggregated to the 0.05° Climate Modeling Grid.
limitations: Land surface (skin) temperature differs from 2 m air temperature, especially over bare desert surfaces in daytime.
Clear-sky only: persistently cloudy months in the north have fewer valid observations.
Terra MODIS acquisitions end on 1 December 2026 (NASA); NASA points users to the VIIRS VJ221C3 / VJ121C3 products for continuity.

access.label: Access at source (NASA Earthdata)
access.notes: NASA Earthdata Login required to download.

algeria_notes: Daytime land surface temperature over the Sahara regularly exceeds air temperature by a wide margin; use anomalies relative to a baseline rather than absolute values when comparing regions.

verification.notes: Metadata from NASA CMR, including the Terra end-of-acquisition notice.

alert: NASA has announced that Terra MODIS acquisitions cease on 1 December 2026. The archive remains available, but the time series will not be extended; NASA points users to equivalent VIIRS products.
